column1: # Type names this tree defines as a file AND an installed Qt or Quickshell
# module also provides. scripts/check-qml-imports.py cannot tell which one a
# file means, so each row here says: in THIS file, this name comes from that
# A row is a declaration, not a skip. It names one file and one type, so it
# cannot widen; and where the Qt module tree is installed the guard READS that
# module and fails if the claim is no longer true, so a row cannot rot into a
# blanket exemption. CI has no Qt modules, which is why the list is tracked
